notes.title: Find Love or Die Trying: Til Death Do Us Part Bugfix Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Hi there!

Auden here.

Thank you so much for playing the afterstory of the original Find Love or Die Trying. I hope you've enjoyed the game! And if you haven't, I promise to work even harder to make better games for you in the future - my goal is to keep improving as a storyteller, and keep making better stories for you.

I'm happy to share that I've now shipped an update that resolves the following issues:

 Fixed an issue where Terra, Kat, or Viola would occasionally fly into the stratosphere to meet aliens when clicking too fast or skipping dialogue
 Fixed an issue where Violet and Yui would occasionally turn into a ninja and hide behind people when clicking too fast or skipping dialogue
 Fixed several typos that suggested Terra was a human (Terran -> Terra)


Thank you so much to the community for supporting the launch and helping me find these bugs!

Sincerely,
Auden Cho-Wong
